title: Mystical Tree of Life
description: A person sees a huge gnarled tree with a round bulbous trunk covered in golden paint marks and branches holding colorful stained glass leaves. The tree grows from a starry reflective pool at the bottom where a white robed figure with flowing cloth touches a circular pattern on the water surface, two hands reach from the sides toward the tree, waterfalls flow from the branches, and a glowing castle sits at the very top under a starry sky with aurora lights.
prompt: A huge gnarled fantasy tree with a round bulbous trunk covered in golden painted marks stands in the center of a starry reflective pool. Its branches hold many colorful stained glass leaves. Waterfalls flow from the tree. A white robed figure with long flowing cloth touches a circular pattern on the water surface. Two hands reach from the sides toward the tree. A glowing castle sits at the top of the tree. The night sky shows stars, shooting stars, and bright green and purple aurora lights. The entire scene is reflected in the dark water below.
